name: Cloudflare D1 Free
free_limit: Workers Free D1: 5 GB total storage, 10 databases/account, 5M rows read/day and 100K rows written/day
watch_out: Daily read/write allowances reset at 00:00 UTC. On Free, exhausted row quotas return query errors and hitting storage cap prevents further writes/schema changes; indexes also count toward stored data and row writes. Workers Paid allows additional billable databases and metered usage. Workers invocation quotas apply separately.
